No one should have to sleep or stay outdoors — especially in this weather. 

If you see someone who is unsheltered and you think they are at risk of hypothermia, call the County’s non-emergency Police phone number (703) 691-2131 TTY 711. 

Learn more: https://t.co/6rPXjGQEDS https://t.co/8Z4UDOL1D2

This week is #WomensHealthWeek, a time to recommit ourselves to the wellness of women and girls and remind ourselves that all healthcare decisions a woman makes are between her and her doctor. https://t.co/eowECiuDvv

Today we officially opened the Wellness Center for Older Adults. Thank you to @ServiceSource1, @JeffreyCMcKay, and @JohnCookVA  for their work on this facility and joining me in its grand opening!  To learn more about this facility: https://t.co/ojBe8jzcmw https://t.co/CcYecF6SKY

Today is #PTSDAwarenessDay, a day to acknowledge the effects of PTSD and the need for effective treatment. 1 in 11 American adults will be diagnosed with PTSD, many of whom are veterans. I hope those in need will take advantage of County resources at https://t.co/jAxb74En53 https://t.co/30aDMHRZu5

Our friends at @ServiceSource1 wrote in the Golden Gazette about my visit to the Wellness Center for Older Adults (WCOA) and the free programs they have to offer. Read more at https://t.co/1VWmTBvXWe. The WCOA is conveniently located at 4027B Olley Lane, Fairfax, VA 22032. https://t.co/0WSbGt8JHt

Throughout the pandemic, airport workers have kept travelers healthy and safe, though that wasn't guaranteed for them. Essential workers deserve better.

I stand with @32BJSEIU airport workers and their fight for paid sick leave + healthcare! #UnionsForAll💜

If you see someone who is unsheltered, and you think they are at risk of hypothermia call the County’s non-emergency Police number at 703-691-2131 and an officer will respond to conduct a wellness check. 

I look forward to volunteering with more Braddock residents next year!

The George Mason University Fairfax Campus will host an ROTC training exercise tomorrow morning. 

Helicopters will come to campus at 6:30am and depart from the West Campus parking lot (closest to Braddock Road) at approximately 8:15am.

Thank you for sharing your fight, Congresswoman Wexton.

We are all thankful for your work as a public servant to ensure others with PD have access to treatment and for spreading awareness.

Devastating news for Virginia and the entire nation. @RepWexton has been an exemplary and courageous leader throughout her career, but especially since her original diagnosis. 

She has made a tremendous positive difference and will continue to do so.

Tomorrow, Saturday, November 4, @FairfaxCountyPD and area law enforcement partners will conduct an annual Search and Rescue (SAR) training exercise in the Burke/Kings Park/Wakefield community between 7am-6pm.

Residents/visitors can expect to see SAR personnel in the area. https://t.co/COtuwcnyuQ

🌙 April 2-8 is International Dark Skies Week

Light pollution has far-reaching effects on both humans and wildlife. It can disrupt sleep patterns, migratory bird paths, and the hunting habits of nocturnal creatures. https://t.co/tlUmoVxgsh
By increasing Virginia's unemployment insurance benefits we can unlock additional federal funds. The time to act is now.

Proud to join former HHS Secretary @XavierBecerra, HRSA Administrator Carole Johnson, and VA Delegates to hold the line for Fairfax families against Trump’s devastating Medicaid cuts. 

As Republicans push a shutdown, I’ll fight for affordable care. https://t.co/c0DzuKC8pC

Trump ordered House Republicans not to work with us—pushing us toward a shutdown unless they can lock in high prices on health care, groceries & everyday goods. 

I’ll keep fighting to protect Medicaid and lower costs for Fairfax families. https://t.co/dUotIMbdPr

In my first Oversight hearing, I called out the truth: as families face rising costs, Medicaid cuts, and a looming shutdown—while Trump hides the Epstein files—House Republicans are busy disenfranchising 700,000 D.C. residents to aid Trump’s power grab. https://t.co/QXsikFdDj4

House Republicans created a health care crisis—slashing Medicaid and raising health care costs. At Trump’s orders, they refuse to work with us. We’re here, ready to negotiate to lower costs. After jamming through their partisan bill, they left. If there’s a shutdown, they own it. https://t.co/IccDaF8NWM

Proud to fight GOP attacks on health care alongside @BobbyScott, @RepDonBeyer, @RepMcClellan & @RepSuhas. 

At today’s press conference with @ProtectOurCare, we urged Republicans to put politics aside & work with us to protect Medicaid & stop ACA premiums from skyrocketing. https://t.co/6CiSsB3kDf

In #VA11, almost 90,000 people rely on Medicaid & more than 36,000 people are enrolled in marketplace health insurance coverage through the ACA. If we don’t cancel the planned cuts & extend premium tax credits, the ranks of uninsured will skyrocket, driving up costs for everyone. https://t.co/i4Kir4D8yk

Clinics like HealthWorks provide vital services, for those with or without health insurance, but as the number of uninsured rises, will they’ll be forced to make difficult decisions and cut back on services, making it harder for people to access care. https://t.co/PxtxplLhi9

Democrats have proposed a budget that will prevent healthcare cuts, stop skyrocketing premiums, and keep the government open. 

But Trump and Republicans won’t even meet to negotiate a bipartisan agreement. Reckless. https://t.co/8gBADpPcMC

Health clinics & providers are preparing for an influx of newly-uninsured patients if we can’t cancel the GOP cuts. I’m fighting for health care, federal workers & a funded gov’t. 

There’s still time for Trump & Republicans to do the right thing: negotiate a bipartisan solution. https://t.co/pXjG1zvrYW

If Trump really is the “deal maker” he sold in books & on TV, now’s the time to prove it. 

He and Republicans should put politics aside and work with Democrats to stop health care premiums from skyrocketing and keep our government funded. https://t.co/sCItZuJmk3

Democrats are here fighting to fund the govt & stop a health care crisis that would send premiums skyrocketing. 

Republicans? 

They’re nowhere to be found, seemingly on vacation. https://t.co/UUkIa8WjdS
